query: 道德采购政策 道德采购政策 衡量企业在采购决策中集成反贿赂、公平贸易、人权保障及环境约束的治理水平。重点考察道德采购标准的系统性、供应商准入尽调、采购团队及供应商培训以及违规问责机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备独立的《道德采购政策》，明确将人权、环境、反贿赂指标纳入供应商准入及考核的“一票否决制”；具备完善的第三方尽职调查流程；设有定期的采购伦理培训；且具备透明的违规处理与社会责任绩效反馈机制。 • 1分（合格）：在采购管理制度中包含道德与环保条款，具备基础的合规审查和廉洁声明，有违约处罚规定，但缺乏跨维度的责任采购标准或系统化的尽调、培训闭环。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关道德采购政策披露，或仅有简单的“成本优先”采购描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：道德采购准则覆盖 >80% 的年度采购总额或关键类别供应商，且披露了通过 ESG 准入审核的供应商占比。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对生产类原材料执行，而忽略了服务性采购或非核心供应商，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 道德采购 负责任采购 公平贸易 采购尽调 一票否决 采购伦理培训 冲突矿产 本地化采购 EcoVadis ethical procurement responsible sourcing fair trade supplier due diligence procurement veto buyer ethics training conflict minerals local procurement EcoVadis 是否有独立《道德采购政策》或等效制度？ 人权、环境、反贿赂是否纳入准入/考核并可一票否决？ 供应商尽调如何开展？ 采购团队与供应商伦理培训如何安排？ 违规问责与社会责任绩效反馈机制是什么？

results.text: During the Reporting Period, the Group actively carried out anti-corruption education for our directors and employees, focusing on the four themes of 'learning and publicizing the spirit of the important conference', 'promoting and interpreting the Party's rules and regulations', 'nurturing the Group's core values and code of conduct' and 'strengthening the construction of an ethical workplace and promoting integrity'. We have carried out 9 on-site education and training programs, covering the Board, the management level, and non-management employees as many as 432 people participating. In addition, we also uploaded video courses for new employees on ethical practices and work integrity to the Pioneer Camp App. Through the exposure and analysis of external cases of violations of laws and disciplines, and organizing the warning education documentaries watching such as 'Integrity and Anti-corruption Around You' and 'National Supervision', we focus on the introduction of laws and regulations such as the Regulations on the Implementation of Supervision Law, and the Opinions on Further Promoting the Investigation of Bribery, which hopefully helps all party members and employees to firmly establish the value of integrity and compliance of 'adhering to the bottom line of discipline, being loyal and ethical, and encouraging outspokenness'.

This 2021 Environmental, Social and Governance (' ESG ') report of the Company (this ' Report ') aims to report on the Group's ESG performances, policies, and strategies during the period from 1 January 2021 to 31 December 2021 (the ' Reporting Period ' or the ' Year '), as disclosed in the various chapters of this Report. results.text: The Group also strictly follows the Code of Conduct Manual, which sets out the operational standards of Sinofert, regulates the compliance behavior of employees, and the standards that we expect our business partners to follow. Managers are required to ensure that employees have received, read, and understood the standards, and to ensure that these standards are implemented in their daily work. Managers can regularly share the cases related to the code of conduct and compliance, organize training, and provide support and guidance at any time to encourage and lead employees' compliance behaviors. All employees must read and understand the code of conduct and sign a letter of commitment to the code of conduct every year. All employees are obliged to immediately report to the Discipline Inspection and Audit and Compliance Department when aware of or suspecting any violation of the code of conduct. Involved issues will then be handled by the Discipline and Compliance Department. In addition, we have also established various reporting channels, and conduct regular updates and maintenance on reporting platforms such as letters, reporting hotlines, emails, and QR codes, to encourage employees and other stakeholders to report any misconduct, dishonest behavior, and corruption. Whistleblowing can be conducted in real name or anonymously to prevent any retaliation against the whistleblower and create a corporate atmosphere where anyone can voice out and speak up.

The Group also strictly follows the Code of Conduct Manual, which sets out the operational standards of Sinofert, regulates the compliance behavior of employees, and the standards that we expect our business partners to follow. Managers are required to ensure that employees have received, read, and understood the standards, and to ensure that these standards are implemented in their daily work. Managers can regularly share the cases related to the code of conduct and compliance, organize training, and provide support and guidance at any time to encourage and lead employees' compliance behaviors. All employees must read and understand the code of conduct and sign a letter of commitment to the code of conduct every year. All employees are obliged to immediately report to the Discipline Inspection and Audit and Compliance Department when aware of or suspecting any violation of the code of conduct. Involved issues will then be handled by the Discipline and Compliance Department. In addition, we have also established various reporting channels, and conduct regular updates and maintenance on reporting platforms such as letters, reporting hotlines, emails, and QR codes, to encourage employees and other stakeholders to report any misconduct, dishonest behavior, and corruption. Whistleblowing can be conducted in real name or anonymously to prevent any retaliation against the whistleblower and create a corporate atmosphere where anyone can voice out and speak up.

results.text: After receiving reported materials, the Discipline and Compliance Department will register and code the case.
